EST. 2019

Flour is more than an ingredient.
It’s the beginning of something good.

Established in 2019, Data Foods brings over 50 years of management experience to a new generation of flour milling in Lahore, Pakistan.

Our single-line mill has the capacity to produce up to 550 metric tonnes every day. It brings scale and experience together to serve households, bakeries, distributors and institutional buyers.
